money_market.source: WIBOR fixings of 22 Jan 2026 (GPW Benchmark delayed data); repo from the Treasury BondSpot Poland session of 22 Jan 2026. Funding = nominal-weighted special repo starting within one day, <= 3 days (3.75%).

irs.source: PLN IRS vs 6M WIBOR at the 22 Jan 2026 close: LSEG end-of-day interbank bid rates in the Erste Bank Polska Codziennik of 23 Jan 2026 (table headed 22.01.2026; only the 22 Jan 2026 levels are used). Bid side, so roughly 1-2bp below mid. 7Y not available. PCHIP interpolation through 6M WIBOR and the pillars; beyond 10Y extrapolated.
irs.short_source: PLN IRS at the 22 Jan 2026 close (LSEG bid via Erste), WIBOR fixings 22 Jan 2026

curve.source: NSS zero curve fitted to BondSpot closing fixings of 22 Jan 2026; front end anchored at a 3M zero of 3.05% = average of sub-1Y fixed POLGB yields (OK0426 2.93%, DS0726 3.12%, PS1026 3.10%).

portfolio_meta._source: GPW Benchmark 'Portfele obligacji' communique for the periodic change of 30 Dec 2025 (holdings as of 22 Dec 2025). PDF metadata shows regeneration on 7 Jan 2026; units reconciled line-by-line with the 26 Nov 2025 file plus MoF auctions/switches/OB operations to 23 Dec 2025, so content reflects pre-cut-off information only.
